body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy or willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, push an enemy 2 units. A willing ally instead moves 2 units without opposition. The movement cannot pass through solid barriers.

surges.html: Move the target horizontally in any direction instead of directly away; a willing ally also gains +1 Fortitude until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Air Thread
rider.html: Gain an Air Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: you may move 1 unit immediately before or after that card, without triggering movement Reactions.
